errors.text_span: спад до около 240 ppm преди 100 000 години
errors.evidence: The value on the chart at the 100,000 year mark is approximately 230 ppm, not 240 ppm. The data point is visually much closer to the 210 ppm tick than the 260 ppm tick.

The description of the horizontal axis fails to mention that its scale is non-uniform. The time intervals between the tick marks are not equal (e.g., the distance between 800,000 and 700,000 is the same as between 100,000 and 0, despite representing different time spans).
The word "рязко" (sharp) is a subjective interpretation of the steepness of the line's slope. The prompt requires objective description and avoidance of interpretation.
